answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is to require new identities to stake a scarce, non-transferable relic earned only through attested work over time. A freshly spun clone has no such relic, so it cannot enter the reputation haven where high-value contracts are matched. Peers can also follow the thread of past settlements on-chain; a burst of lookalike accounts with no shared history is easy to quarantine before they dilute consensus.
